title: HWiNFO64 — What HWiNFO64 does
description: HWiNFO64 by REALiX is the most complete hardware monitoring suite on Windows: it reads every temperature, voltage, fan, clock, and power sensor the machine exposes. Enthusiasts call it the ultimate because nothing else shows this much, this accurately, for free.

title: HWiNFO64 — Voltage rails
description: The voltage section shows Vcore, memory voltage, and the PSU's 12V, 5V, and 3.3V rails as reported by the board's Super I/O chip. A 12V rail drooping toward 11.4V under load is an early warning that the power supply is struggling.

title: HWiNFO64 — Polling rate
description: The global polling period sets how often every sensor is re-read; 500 to 1000 ms suits most monitoring, while fast transient hunting goes lower. Faster polling smooths graphs but costs a little CPU of its own.
